title: Here’s to all the people who made @SCHMIGADOON! on Broadway happen!
transcript: right now on the schmigadoon marquee they are scrolling through the names of every single person that works on the show both on stage behind the stage and front of the house this is a really cool congratulations to schmigadoon for winning Best Musical last night and this is a great way to acknowledge all of the people that Make a best musical happen
classificationReason: Creator films the Schmigadoon marquee scrolling through crew/staff names and congratulates the show on winning Best Musical at the Tonys. No personal opinion about the production itself — this is commentary on the Tony win and the marquee gesture.
